highlights: **Sessions open without spawning**: reading a session never starts an agent process (lazy open), and hosted sessions get a snapshot view, a switch API and an agent badge in the UI
**New `aiti-interaction` MCP toolset**: a desktop interaction daemon with dialog/cover windows, form input patterns, custom pages and async MCP tools — AI can drive real GUI dialogs end to end
**Extension updates you can trust**: `aiti-extman` checks updates from two sources with persisted verdicts, and extension metadata (names, taglines, feature groups) is now localized
**Duplicate bridge registration self-check**: the TUI bridge and the `aiti_*` bundle detect double loading at startup and yield automatically, ending the "Tool conflicts" class of errors

**Sharper chrome everywhere**: semantic icons on every `aiti-msg-smart` popover action, one line-icon system across the extension list, a compact two-column `aiti-ui-env` panel with restart-proof helper supervision, and provider icons fixed under sub-path deployments

**New extension `aiti-feedback`**: a sanitized in-app feedback form that opens a prefilled GitHub issue — tokens, private IP ranges and home directories are redacted before anything leaves the browser

**Secret stack v2 lands end-to-end**: an encrypted secret vault with a pre-send credential gate in the composer, shape/context-based secret detection (`secret-mask-core` 0.4), and the DSH port re-aligned on the same core

**A wider extension surface**: `aiti-sysmon` CPU/memory chips, `aiti-ai-schedule` event triggers (fs-watch / process-exit / webhook), `aiti-editor` and `aiti-sheet-univer` in-app editing, `aiti-folder` live directory watch, `aiti-ai-speek` local TTS, and a layered fleet view for `aiti-subagents`

**Chat that survives the page**: busy compact requests are parked server-side across reloads, forked sessions keep their live ids, IME composition no longer submits early, and session notice toasts dismiss by tap, swipe or button

**Top-bar and sidebar density work**: the `sessionStatsInline` slot condenses the stats row into a single flow, and the sidebar dock contract now covers channels, folder and the rest of the dock panels

**Upstream baseline 0.17.0**: the host app merges the upstream 0.17.0 release and is re-cut as a single-source repository — host app, 60+ extensions, packages, integrations and the release tooling now live in one tree

**Survive-restart agent hosting** goes end-to-end: detachable agent processes that outlive a host restart, a detach/start-in-process round-trip in the UI, per-session hosting preference across cold cycles, and a Windows runner (named-pipe endpoints)
**New extension `aiti-containers`**: container management panel (containers/images/volumes/networks, compose projects, live stats) built for the AI window
**Secret stack v2**: redaction engine rewrite, encrypted vault with a web UI, and the DSH build aligned at 0.2.0
**25-provider ACP family is now detachable** — external agents (qoder, codebuddy and friends) can be hosted in wrappers that survive restarts
New extension **aiti-msg-share**: share conversations and messages to pluggable targets

Four more new extensions: **pi-secret-mask** (deterministic secret redaction), **aiti-testagent** (Java backend debugging), **aiti-git-ops** (whitelisted git write engine) and **aiti-backup** (snapshot backup for large state data)
**aiti-editor**: selection cards now work across same-origin and cross-origin previews
Broad bilingual (en/zh) i18n sweep: 20+ extensions moved to keyed tables, plus cross-extension label translation infrastructure
File-based release notes pipeline (drafts land in `releases/` and gate tagging)
